title: The Basement Pool
content: The other night, I dreamt of a new place that has the Mallworld vibe to it. Seems to be what is at the end of the green/blue carpeted stairways others on this sub have observed as well. There is a large rectangular pool room with an arched ceiling alot like irl Egyptian tombs, but without tons of hieroglyphics and paintings and such, just white, smooth stucco. The water looks like it's been dyed turquoise, and the walls are painted on one side with a faux sunset scene. There is a whole beach and "island", the sand being instead tons of seashell slices. The buildings are human sized but look like amusement park props or fishbowl knic-knacs. Kindof a cheesy pirate/1800s miner town vibe. There is a small fqctory building of some sort up on stilts with wood panels missing, and the sound of a waterfall on the "hillside". There are also these massive flowers growing out of some places that look like a mix of mechanical gears and irl cacti or succulents. A troll or gnome looking person had me (in the dream) climb into a tree, then he pulled the top of the tree back with rope and I got launched at the wall. Woke up irl before I knew if I broke through the wall or not.
